greeting: Ahoy, surface-walker! Deep-Diver Darius, at your service!
Back from the depths! You should see what's down there!
The sea gives and the sea takes. Mostly gives, lately!
You look like someone who stays dry. Boring!
Welcome to Abyssal Station! Last stop before the REALLY deep water!
I dive so you don't have to! But you should! It's AMAZING!
The pressure down there's incredible! Like a full-body hug! From a giant!
New face! Want to hear about what I found in the trench?
dialog.dive_stories: Last dive, I saw a whale. Bigger than a building. Looked at me. I looked at it. We had a MOMENT.
dialog.suit_explanation: This suit? Retro design. Built to withstand CRUSHING depths. Also, looks FANTASTIC. Style matters, even underwater.
dialog.pressure_tolerance: You get used to the pressure. Eventually. Ears pop for the first hour. Then? Just you and the deep.
dialog.treasure_finding: Found a whole SHIPWRECK last week! Ancient! Full of... barnacles. But HISTORIC barnacles!
rumor: There's something BIG in the Midnight Trench. Bigger than big. Haven't seen it. Felt it.
Old sailors say the Mire and Tide connect underground. Same water, different attitude.
Frost has ice diving. Different suit. Same crazy.
Prism's got underwater crystals. Bioluminescent. Want to see that someday.
dialog.sunken_treasure_quest_hook: Found a MAP in that shipwreck! Leads to the 'Sunken Crown' - legendary treasure! But I need someone... surface-capable... to help retrieve it. The exit's on land. Awkward for me. Interested?
dialog.sunken_treasure_quest_active: The map shows coordinates in the Kelp Forest. There's a cave. The Crown's inside. Supposedly. Good luck!
dialog.sunken_treasure_quest_complete: You found it! THE SUNKEN CROWN! Beautiful! And you got it out! Here - take this. My spare depth gauge. Measures pressure. And coolness. You're definitely cool now.
farewell: Stay dry! Or don't! Diving's more fun!
If you see bubbles, say hi! Might be me!
Safe travels! And if you get a diving suit, look me up!
The sea calls! I must answer! SPLASH!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning dive! Best visibility! Let's GO!
dialog.time_noon: Surface interval. Eating. Hydrating. Telling stories.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening return! Last dive of the day!
dialog.time_night: Night diving? Too spooky. Even for me.

party_reactions.kade: Diving that deep takes serious courage. Respect.
party_reactions.nix7: Depth tolerance: exceptional. Suit technology: retro but functional.
party_reactions.twist: You go UNDERWATER?! In THAT?! That's AMAZING!
party_reactions.korr: The deep sea holds many secrets. You find them well.
party_reactions.renna: Does your suit have magical wardings? Against pressure?
party_reactions.suresh: To explore the unknown is a noble calling.
party_reactions.sova: I'd try diving. Once. Then probably drown.
party_reactions.grit: We had divers in the navy. Tougher than they looked.
party_reactions.ashka: Water puts out fire. Not a fan. But I respect the bravery.
party_reactions.senna: Underwater is... quiet. Good for hiding.
party_reactions.callum: Isn't it scary down there? In the dark?

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're back! Want to hear about my latest dive?
relationship_dialog.friend: My surface friend! Come to check on me?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! My favorite land-walker! Here - have my lucky diving helmet. Spare, of course.

mini_quest.title: Sunken Treasure
mini_quest.description: Retrieve the Sunken Crown from the Kelp Forest cave

stages.hook: Found a MAP leading to the 'Sunken Crown'! But the exit's on land. Awkward for me. Help me retrieve it?
stages.active: The map shows coordinates in the Kelp Forest. Cave entrance. Crown inside. Be careful of the currents!
stages.complete: You found it! THE SUNKEN CROWN! Here - take my spare depth gauge. And my eternal gratitude!
